disclosures: Per Florida Statute 83.49, the landlord must return the deposit within 15 days if no claim is made, or within 30 days with an itemized claim by certified mail.
Tenant has 15 days to object to the claim after receiving notice.
notes: Florida requires certified mail for deposit claim notices.
If no deductions, return deposit within 15 days. With deductions, itemized notice within 30 days.
